# The Boston Globe
> Regional and national journalism covering Boston, New England, politics, business, sports, culture, and opinion.

The Boston Globe is a major news organization serving Boston and New England with breaking news, enterprise reporting, investigations, commentary, and lifestyle coverage. Its site includes core newsroom sections, newsletters, podcasts, subscriber products, and topic hubs for local communities, state politics, and Boston sports.

## News
- [Home](https://www.bostonglobe.com/): Front page featuring top stories, breaking news, and major coverage across the newsroom.
- [Metro](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro): Boston and regional news covering communities, public safety, transit, and local issues.
- [Politics](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/politics): Massachusetts and New England political news, campaigns, government, and public policy coverage.
- [Nation](https://www.bostonglobe.com/nation): National news with reporting on US politics, policy, courts, and current events.
- [World](https://www.bostonglobe.com/world): International news, conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [Obituaries](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/obituaries): Obituaries and remembrances of notable people from Boston and beyond.

## New England & Local Coverage
- [Massachusetts](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts): Statewide reporting on Massachusetts communities, policy, education, and local developments.
- [Rhode Island](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/rhode-island): News and reporting focused on Rhode Island politics, communities, and regional issues.
- [New Hampshire](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/new-hampshire): Coverage of New Hampshire politics, local news, and statewide developments.
- [Maine](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/maine): Reporting on Maine communities, government, environment, and regional affairs.
- [Vermont](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/vermont): Vermont news covering politics, communities, and public policy.
- [Cambridge & Somerville](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts/cambridge-somerville): Local coverage of Cambridge and Somerville neighborhoods, government, and community issues.
- [Greater Boston](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/regionals/greater-boston): Regional reporting on cities and towns across Greater Boston.

## Investigations & Accountability
- [Spotlight](https://www.bostonglobe.com/spotlight): Investigative journalism and accountability reporting from the Globe Spotlight Team.
- [The Great Divide](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2023/01/23/metro/the-great-divide/): Coverage examining inequality, housing, race, and opportunity in Greater Boston.
- [Education](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/education): Reporting on schools, colleges, policy, and education systems across the region.
- [Transportation](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/transportation): News on the MBTA, commuting, infrastructure, and transportation policy.
- [Weather](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/weather): Forecasts, storm coverage, climate-related reporting, and weather updates.

## Business & Technology
- [Business](https://www.bostonglobe.com/business): Business news covering companies, markets, labor, real estate, and the regional economy.
- [Technology](https://www.bostonglobe.com/business/technology): Reporting on startups, tech companies, innovation, and digital policy.
- [Healthcare](https://www.bostonglobe.com/business/health-care): News on hospitals, biotech, public health, and the healthcare industry.
- [Real Estate](https://www.bostonglobe.com/business/real-estate): Coverage of housing markets, development, affordability, and commercial property.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.bostonglobe.com/business/personal-finance): Advice and reporting on money, taxes, retirement, and household finances.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports): Main sports hub with Boston team coverage, scores, analysis, and columns.
- [Red Sox](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/baseball/redsox): Boston Red Sox news, game coverage, roster moves, and analysis.
- [Patriots](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/football/patriots): New England Patriots coverage including games, draft, and offseason news.
- [Bruins](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/hockey/bruins): Boston Bruins reporting with game stories, analysis, and roster updates.
- [Celtics](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/basketball/celtics): Boston Celtics news, playoffs, player coverage, and NBA analysis.
- [Revolution](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/soccer/revolution): New England Revolution and regional soccer coverage.
- [Women’s Sports](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/women): Coverage of women’s professional, college, and local sports.
- [College Sports](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/colleges): NCAA and local college athletics coverage across New England.
- [High Schools](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/high-schools): Massachusetts high school sports news, rankings, and results.

## Opinion
- [Opinion](https://www.bostonglobe.com/opinion): Editorials, columns, op-eds, and commentary on politics and public life.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.bostonglobe.com/opinion/editorials): Institutional editorials from the Globe’s editorial board.
- [Letters](https://www.bostonglobe.com/opinion/letters): Reader letters responding to current events and Globe coverage.
- [Ideas](https://www.bostonglobe.com/ideas): Essays and analysis on culture, politics, society, and intellectual life.
- [Opinion Columnists](https://www.bostonglobe.com/opinion/columnists): Commentary from Globe opinion writers and contributing columnists.

## Arts, Lifestyle & Culture
- [Arts](https://www.bostonglobe.com/arts): Coverage of visual arts, theater, music, books, and cultural events.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.bostonglobe.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle reporting on food, travel, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Food](https://www.bostonglobe.com/lifestyle/food-dining): Restaurant news, reviews, recipes, and dining coverage.
- [Travel](https://www.bostonglobe.com/lifestyle/travel): Travel ideas, destination features, and practical trip reporting.
- [Magazine](https://www.bostonglobe.com/magazine): Longform features, profiles, and narrative journalism from Boston Globe Magazine.
- [Names](https://www.bostonglobe.com/lifestyle/names): Celebrity, media, and local personalities coverage.
- [Books](https://www.bostonglobe.com/arts/books): Book reviews, author interviews, and literary coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.bostonglobe.com/arts/movies): Film reviews, industry news, and movie features.

## Special Products & Subscriber Features
- [Today’s Paper](https://www.bostonglobe.com/todayspaper): Digital replica and curated presentation of the day’s newspaper edition.
- [Crosswords](https://www.bostonglobe.com/crossword-puzzles): Crossword puzzles and games for readers and subscribers.
- [Newsletters](https://www.bostonglobe.com/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major topics, beats, and Globe products.
- [Podcasts](https://www.bostonglobe.com/podcasts): Podcast hub featuring Globe audio journalism and talk shows.
- [Subscriber Services](https://www.bostonglobe.com/subscriber-services): Account help, delivery, billing, and subscription support resources.
- [Manage My Account](https://www.bostonglobe.com/my-account): Account management for subscriptions, profile settings, and preferences.

- [Contact Us](https://www.bostonglobe.com/about/contact): Contact information for departments, tips, and customer support.
- [Staff List](https://www.bostonglobe.com/about/staff-list): Directory of Globe journalists, editors, and newsroom staff.
- [Work at The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobemedia.com/careers/): Careers and job openings across Boston Globe Media.
- [Advertise](https://www.bostonglobemedia.com/advertise/): Advertising and marketing solutions for print, digital, and branded campaigns.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/privacy-policy): Privacy practices and data handling policies for Globe users.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/terms): Terms governing use of bostonglobe.com and related services.
